loop_uncertainty.scope: Scalar marker-distance calibration only. All admitted runtime loops retained. GT-gap/near-zero-baseline exclusions affect observer labels only. Same-query edges carry total calibration weight 1; Shared match/query endpoints are grouped explicitly; no independent-sample confidence interval is claimed. No full-SE3 qualification or changed runtime weights; no GT in estimator.

robust_loop_audit.scope: Observer-only existing Cauchy model (delta 1), frozen final graph. No edges removed or weights changed. Graph-conditioned central subset is a diagnostic, not an unbiased calibration set; all observable edges remain reported.

m2_signal_clocks.scope: Independent gate_02 timing audit, not an accuracy score. GNSS velocity is consumer-grade UBLOX, not Xsens truth. Compare angular/speed magnitudes without GT orientation alignment; only first 60 s determines fixed lag for holdout. No runtime timestamps or scoring convention changed.

m2_hall_course_clock.scope: Planar-course proxy under predominantly forward/reverse wheeled motion, not body-attitude truth. Turn-in-place and low-speed motion excluded by >0.3 m/s course speed. Three symmetric smoothing windows test stability. Raw gyro and released Leica positions only; no LIO trajectory. Per-window diagnostic lags never enter runtime or official scores.

m2_reference_sensitivity.interpretation: Manufacturer states MTi-680(G) compensated position refers to the IMU when the antenna lever arm is configured; default arm is zero. Dataset sensor settings/export metadata are absent. Keep nominal IMU-reference scores; antenna and +50 ms truth queries are observer sensitivity only. +50 ms was fitted from first-60s raw gyro versus GT angular speed, not position scores. No runtime or GT files changed.
